_readme: Provenance for every image a Wellington blog article may reference. An image renders on a Wellington article only if its locality is exactly "Wellington" and it has a source and a verification note. File names prove nothing. Entries marked provisional are recorded for Wellington but the exact venue is unconfirmed; the audit reports them on every run. Enforced by scripts/audit-city-images.mjs (runs before every build) and tested by scripts/wellington-image-guard.test.mjs. To add a photo: add it here first, with where it was taken and how that was established.

images.landmark: Polo field and grandstand, spectator side (venue not named)
images.source: John Oliver, iPhone 12 Pro, 2022-01-30 (EXIF), one polo shoot from the spectator side of the field
images.verification: Provisional. The folder, file names and John's earlier captions place this shoot in Wellington, and the sideline boards read U.S. Polo Assn., which points to the National Polo Center - Wellington. The EXIF block has no GPS, so the exact venue is not confirmed by the photographer. Do not caption any frame with a venue name until John confirms it.
images.shows: A winter polo match on a grass field in front of a grandstand
